kellogg's pop-tarts breakfast toaster pastries are ready to eat right out of the package
refreeze upon arrival and keep frozen until ready to serve. warm for a few seconds in the microwave to enhance taste and texture.

toasting directions 1. set toaster or toaster oven on low to medium setting. 2. toast frozen pastry 1 to 2 cycles or until hot and golden brown. 3. remove from toaster or toaster oven. (do not use metal utensil to remove pastry.) caution: pastry will be hot! 4. tear or cut off icing packet along perforation. tear or cut across top of packet. squeeze icing onto hot pastry.
